Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0457881
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
MP / R0 170002781
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
As the customer reported, both cables are cut and need to be replaced.
I will send you the reference number for the required cable. Please note that you will need two cables, one for each side.
Charging Cable: 8EM5903-0AA02-6AA2 CCS2 250A 1000V – 5.82 m
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility DE-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
